target.title: fix(worker): verify Hetzner cleanup ownership
target.body:
## Summary

- re-read a persisted Hetzner server before coordinator cleanup
- require canonical Crabbox, provider, lease, and slug ownership labels on that exact server ID
- fail closed before deleting either the server or its retained SSH key when ownership does not match
- add regression coverage and an Unreleased changelog entry

Fixes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/873

## Verification

- `npm test --prefix worker -- fleet.test.ts -t Hetzner` (26 passed)
- `npm test --prefix worker` (790 passed)
- `npm run format:check --prefix worker`
- `npm run lint --prefix worker`
- `npm run check --prefix worker`
- `npm run build --prefix worker`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --stream-engine-output` (clean; no accepted/actionable findings)

## Live gate

No provider resources were created. The only locally configured Hetzner token is rejected by the provider, and no valid Hetzner credential is currently available in 1Password. Keep this PR unmerged until an exact-head disposable canary proves owned deletion, unowned denial, and zero residue, or that item-specific gate is explicitly waived.
